anomalies.expected: For a high-side P-MOSFET switch driven by an NPN transistor, a DC pull-up resistor from gate to source/VCC is required so that when Q2 is off the gate returns to source and Q1 turns off. A capacitor alone cannot provide the DC pull-up.
